title: 第9章 嚣张的小苏凡第10章 不装了摊牌了
slug: 邪鼎第3739章本祖是她的师尊
content_zh:
火烈鸟的背上，两道身影迎风而立。
正是薛长山和徐娇娇。
“亲自护送？”
苏凡忍不住感慨。
这就是待遇。
哪像许三阴，把他带回宗门，便不管不顾，完全就是一副让他自生自灭的态度。
有时候。
他都忍不住怀疑，许三阴真的在乎这场决斗吗？
这是在乎的态度？
敢情是破罐子破摔吧！
……
滚滚热浪席卷而来，火烈鸟停在离地三米的虚空，薛长山和徐娇娇跳下来。
“拜见师尊。”
赵宇走过去，躬身行礼。
“恩。”
薛长山点头，扫视着决斗场，问道：“许三阴还没来？”
现在的决斗场已经是人山人海，所以薛长山，没注意到站在人群角落里的苏凡和冷月。
“没看到。”
“估计是怕了吧，毕竟一个废灵体，怎么可能打得过身为火元素灵体的徐师妹。”
赵宇摇头一笑。

“现在怕？晚了。”
老魔头，那件宝贝，今天必是我薛长山的囊中之物。
片刻过去。
伴随着尖锐刺耳的鸟鸣，许三阴终于驾着火烈鸟，来到决斗场。
薛长山抬头看去，呵呵笑道：“老许，我还以为你不敢来呢！”
“今天这一战，谁赢谁输还不一定。”
虽然并没有什么底气，但嘴上逞强的功夫，绝对不能输。
“是吗？”
“可怎么就你一个人，苏凡呢？难不成跑了？如果他真的跑了，那你就等于认输了。”
薛长山满脸玩味。
在他看来，苏凡跑路的可能性很大。
毕竟一个废灵体，半个月的时间，修为能长进多少？
“他敢跑？”
许三阴冷笑一声，扫视着人群，终于在人群里，看到了苏凡和冷月。
“没跑就好。”薛长山哈哈一笑，转头看向徐娇娇，说道：“去吧！”
content_en:
On the back of the flamingo, two figures stood facing the wind.
It was Xue Changshan and Xu Jiaojiao.
"Personally escorted?"
Su Fan couldn't help but sigh.
This is the treatment.
Unlike Xu Sanyin, who took him back to the sect and ignored him, completely letting him fend for himself.
sometimes.
He couldn't help but wonder, did Xu Sanyin really care about this duel?
Is this an attitude of caring?
Dare love be a broken jar!
…
A rolling heat wave swept over, and the flamingo stopped in the void three meters above the ground. Xue Changshan and Xu Jiaojiao jumped down.
"Meet the Master."
Zhao Yu walked over and bowed.
"Yeah."
Xue Changshan nodded, glanced around the duel field, and asked, "Xu Sanyin hasn't come yet?"
The duel arena was already crowded, so Xue Changshan did not notice Su Fan and Leng Yue standing in the corner of the crowd.
"Didn't see it."
"I guess I'm scared. After all, how can a waste spirit be able to defeat Junior Sister Xu, who is a fire element spirit."
Zhao Yu shook his head and smiled.
"Afraid now? It's too late."
Old devil, that treasure must be in my possession today, Xue Changshan.
A moment passes.
Accompanied by the sharp and piercing chirping of birds, Xu Sanyin finally drove the flamingo to the duel field.
Xue Changshan looked up and laughed: "Old Xu, I thought you didn't dare to come!"
“In today’s battle, it’s not certain who will win and who will lose.”
Although he doesn't have much confidence, he can never lose the skill of showing off his words.
"Really?"
"But why are you alone, where is Su Fan? Could it be that he ran away? If he really ran away, then you would have given up."
Xue Changshan's face was filled with amusement.
In his opinion, there was a high possibility that Su Fan would run away.
After all, how much can a useless spirit body improve in cultivation in half a month?
"He dares to run?"
Xu Sanyin sneered, scanned the crowd, and finally saw Su Fan and Leng Yue in the crowd.
"It's good that you didn't run away." Xue Changshan laughed, turned to look at Xu Jiaojiao, and said, "Go!"
